title: Safe commands with a variable in the path are refused
what: The guard reads an unquoted $NAME/... word as a path under the current folder, so safe commands with a variable in the path are refused.
why: Safe commands are refused for no reason, and a worker is stopped in the middle of its job.
failing_case: from the main checkout `git -C $G branch -d x` (a worktree in `$G`) is refused: the guard takes an unquoted `$NAME/...` word as a path under the current folder (`guard-main.sh:39-41`); the same mechanism refuses writes to `$TMPDIR/...` and `mkdir -p $S` (handover "guard-main reads -C $VAR as a literal path", "guard and $TMPDIR", earlier note at handover:144; the `$TMPDIR` case is the coordinator's shorthand, confirmed by the taker)
